verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is an invoicing and billing product, so configurable pricing models are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack documents only recurring invoices, credit notes and billable-expense conversion. Nothing shows tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit or hybrid subscription-plus-usage pricing, nor commitments or overage. Credit notes are an adjacent feature, not usage credits.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code
